Seeking to develop long-term solutions to overcrowded prisons, the Justice Sector Coordinating Council (JSCC) held the second day of the Second National Decongestion Summit on January 22, 2026, in Manila. The JSCC is composed of the #SupremeCourtPH (SC), the Department of Justice (DOJ), and the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).

Day 2 of the Summit was led by SC Associate Justice Maria Filomena D. Singh, joining around 250 justice sector leaders, policymakers, corrections administrators, and experts in discussions on sustainable approaches to easing jail and prison congestion. This underscored the Judiciary’s central role in driving case flow reforms, strengthening Justice Zones, and ensuring more timely justice delivery.

The second day of the Summit featured in-depth discussions on justice reforms, highlighting lived-experience participation in policymaking, restorative justice frameworks, gender-responsive protocols for women in conflict with the law, and efforts to democratize Good Conduct Time Allowance (GCTA) calculation.
